snippet.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 - Meet The Devs New Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Meet some of the developers behind PowerWash Simulator 2 and marvel at these new looks at gameplay! PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!
